extracted.intended_audience: journalists, designers, communications and marketing staff preparing materials for Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley (BGCAZ)
extracted.subtask_description: Brand and editorial rules for producing communications (press releases, web copy, social media, marketing collateral) for Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley, including name usage, logos, colors, and social handles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission & Vision Statements
rubrics_metrics.description:
Mission: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley empowers young people, especially those who need us most, to reach their full potential as productive, caring, responsible members of the community.
Vision: To be the premier out-of-school-time provider and leading voice for youth development in Arizona, ensuring youth and teens have the skills and resilience to successfully navigate childhood and prepare for adulthood.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these exact statements as the organization's core messaging where appropriate. For questions or permissions, contact marketing@bgcaz.org or +1 602 954 8182.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logos — configurations & assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley has vertical and horizontal configurations of our logo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided official logo files (Download Logos (EPS)). Select vertical or horizontal configuration as appropriate for layout and sizing. Contact marketing for usage questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name usage — singular, no definite article
rubrics_metrics.description: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley is singular. Do not precede with 'the.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Correct example: 'Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley is dedicated to empowering youth.'
Incorrect example: 'The Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley are dedicated to empowering youth.' Ensure subject-verb agreement by treating the organization name as a singular proper noun.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ampersand in organization name
rubrics_metrics.description: Always use the ampersand (&) in the name of our organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Correct: 'Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley'
Incorrect: 'Boys and Girls Clubs of the Valley'. Always render the official name with '&' in all communications and titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of 'Club(s)'
rubrics_metrics.description: Club / Clubs - Always capitalize Club(s), in both the phrase Boys & Girls Club(s) and when using it alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When referencing an individual Club or Clubs collectively, capitalize the word 'Club' to match organizational style (e.g., 'the Club offers programs').

rubrics_metrics.name: 'The Boys & Girls Club Movement' usage and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: The Boys & Girls Club Movement - Refers to BGCA and Clubs collectively. Club is singular. Movement is capitalized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When referring to the national movement of affiliated Clubs and BGCA, use the capitalized phrase 'The Boys & Girls Club Movement' and treat 'Club' as singular within that phrase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of 'club member' / 'members'
rubrics_metrics.description: Club member - Young people who registered with the Club; 'members' is not capitalized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Club member' (capitalized 'Club', lowercase 'member') when referring to registered young people. Do not capitalize 'members' when used generically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acronym usage: BGCAZ
rubrics_metrics.description: Our acronym is BGCAZ. When referring to our organization in an article, please begin the article by calling us Boys & Girls Clubs of the Valley. In following sentences, you can refer to us as BGCAZ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Correct: 'BGCAZ'
Incorrect: 'bgcaz'
Incorrect: 'B.G.C.A.Z.' Always introduce the full name first, then use the uppercase acronym BGCAZ in subsequent references; do not use periods or lowercase forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color palette — primary and extended colors with specs
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Primary Color is BGCA Blue. The Extended Palette includes the remaining 6 colors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Use the specified color values for consistent branding. Provided specs:
- BGCA Blue: PMS PROCESS BLUE; CMYK 100/13/1/2; RGB 0/129/198; HEX 0081C6
- Inspirational Green: PMS 376 C; CMYK 54/0/100/0; RGB 132/189/0; HEX 84BF00
- Professional Blue: PMS 301 C; CMYK 100/53/4/19; RGB 0/75/135; HEX 004B87
- Service Purple: PMS 267 C; CMYK 77/97/0/0; RGB 73/47/146; HEX 492F92
- Theatrical Gray: PMS COOL GRAY 11 C; CMYK 44/34/22/77; RGB 83/86/90; HEX 53565A
- Energetic Orange: PMS 151 C; CMYK 0/60/100/0; RGB 255/130/0; HEX FF8200
- Bold Black: PMS Black C; CMYK 0/0/0/100; RGB 0/0/0; HEX 000000
Apply these exact values in print and digital design to maintain brand consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media & web handles
rubrics_metrics.description: Websites: BGCAZ.org, AZYouthforce.org, MesaArtsAcademy.org. Acronym: BGCAZ. Social Media Handles: @BGCArizona, @MesaArtsAcademy, @AZYouthforce.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed official websites and social handles in external communications and link to the organization's social profiles. Use the acronym BGCAZ for short references to the organization on social platforms and materials. Provide links to all social media handles where requested.
